transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. When can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Please avoid heavy work or straining for a month.  

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you! When can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running out, your GP should be able to provide more.  

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
A bit of sensitivity to light can be normal as your eye adjusts. If it’s mild, wearing sunglasses outside can help. But if it’s severe, or the eye is red and painful as well, that’s not normal and we may need to check it further.  

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I have one more question. Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after surgery. It should improve quickly and settle down over time. If it is still blurry, or getting worse, we may need to check it.  

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I have no more questions. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they have. Thank you very much!

verdict.label: pass
verdict.reasoning: The agent conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` ("A bit of sensitivity to light can be normal as your eye adjusts.") and `mild_case_advice` ("If it’s mild, wearing sunglasses outside can help.") in the same turn. It also conveyed `escalation_criteria` ("But if it’s severe, or the eye is red and painful as well, that’s not normal and we may need to check it further.") in that same turn. All points were covered.
